questions.stem: You are seeing Mr. Sunil in the urgent care clinic. He is a 53-year-old man complaining of occasional, pressure-like chest discomfort. The discomfort seems to worsen when he exerts himself, and he has to stop when climbing stairs to allow it to dissipate. You suspect coronary artery disease, and he is not amenable to any invasive testing such as coronary angiography. Which noninvasive test given here has the highest sensitivity currently for detecting 50–70% stenosis in major coronary arteries?
